content.text: Apostille for Europe – A Growing Need for Indian Professionals and Students

Europe continues to be one of the most sought-after destinations for Indian professionals, students, and families — from tech jobs in Germany to university degrees in France and cultural exchange programs in Italy. But a key prerequisite stands in the way: apostille certification.
If you're planning to move to Europe, this guide will help you understand how to get your documents apostilled in India and why it's essential.
Why Apostille is Required for Europe

Most European countries are members of the Hague Convention of 1961, which abolished the need for embassy legalization. Instead, they require an apostille stamp on your Indian documents to prove their authenticity.
